name: Fiat 125 Coupe SE78 IAVA
description: The Fiat 125 Coupe SE78 IAVA was a limited special edition released in 1978 to celebrate IAVA's sporting success. This enhanced variant featured a tuned 1.6L twin-cam engine producing 120 hp, improved suspension, and distinctive badging. Created as a homologation special for competition, only a small number were produced, making it one of the most coveted and collectible Argentine-built Fiats. The SE78 represents the pinnacle of IAVA's engineering prowess and racing heritage.
author: Simfactor Argentina
